source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: Pick one [Daemon Primarch of Slaanesh](vsdata:ability/emperors-children.fulgrim.daemon-primarch-of-slaanesh) option at the start of the opponent’s [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase). This choice grants Fulgrim **[Fights First](vsdata:core-rule/fights-first)**. It expires as the opponent begins their next [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase).
